verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec. The probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt file is a documentation index, not an API spec. The MCP server's ability to 'inspect endpoint schemas' is an adjacent feature, not a downloadable specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
